scope_notes: We check rain, heat, cold, snow, wind and recent rain. We don't yet check thunderstorms, hail, freezing rain or ice, wildfire, air quality, coastal flooding, or geological hazards. For those, follow official warnings.
Thunderstorms are not checked. Storms are a major cause of weather deaths — follow official storm warnings.
The history data is a ~25 km grid and misses very local storms.
Groundtruth covers weather-driven hazards only. For landslides, glacier collapse or earthquakes, check local civil protection and geological authorities.

reply.headline: Typical rain, temperature, snow and wind for Porticello, Sicily, Italy on 19 Aug 2024.
why: Normal rain for the last 6 days (13.8 mm) was the check that set the level, with 11.3 mm falling over the 5 days before and the rest forecast for the day itself.

Days with this much rain over 6 days happen about 21 times a year here now, against about 24 times a year in 1951–1980, which does not make the day any less serious because the level is based on the recent 30 years.
Normal highs for here (feels like up to 33 °C) are 2.0 times more common here than in 1951–1980.
Normal wind for here (gusts up to 45 km/h) matches 1951–1980, which was about as common.
